sourceOccurrences.label: The conformal-radius clock
sourceOccurrences.locator: Annals of Mathematics161(2005), Lemma6.3 proof, (6.3), printed pp.904–905
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Written proof from explicit foundational tools
sourceOccurrences.note: Direct Loewner/Itô calculation identifies logarithmic inverse radius with the lifetime of the angular diffusion. The maximal-clock argument is included; ordinary SLE only.

sourceOccurrences.label: Exact inverse-radius moments
sourceOccurrences.locator: Annals of Mathematics161(2005), Lemma6.3, (6.6)–(6.9), printed pp.903–906
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Written proof from explicit foundational tools
sourceOccurrences.note: Alternative written proof for every 0<kappa<8 and real p<1-kappa/8. Euler positivity supplies a uniform lower bound and justifies finite moments before optional stopping; negative moments are handled separately.

sourceOccurrences.label: Sharp threshold and the kappa8 transition
sourceOccurrences.locator: Annals of Mathematics161(2005), Lemma6.3, printed pp.903–906
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Written proof from explicit foundational tools
sourceOccurrences.note: A positive angular eigenfunction gives a survival lower bound and divergence at the endpoint. A scale-function argument proves infinite radius-clock lifetime for kappa>=8, including equality.

sourceOccurrences.label: Terminal boundary-distance exponent
sourceOccurrences.locator: Annals of Mathematics161(2005), Equation(6.2), printed pp.903–904; consequence of Lemma6.3
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Written proof from explicit foundational tools
sourceOccurrences.note: Koebe and the moment/survival bounds give the distance exponent. The statement uses Loewner-domain boundaries; identifying the full trace and proving its dimension remain separate.
